interpretation: Player shoves the guard into the flames engulfing the door.

modifiers.label: guard fixated on the fire, not the player
guard already on edge from the fire, quick to react

narration_on_success: The guard barely turns before the player drives him backward into the blaze — he stiffens, then crumples, unconscious, at the foot of the burning door.
narration_on_failure: The guard catches himself on the doorframe and rounds on the player with a hard shove of his own. "You're done," he snarls, eyes as bright as the fire behind him.
